module_summary: Sequential 16-bit unsigned shift-and-add multiplier: a bit counter steps through multiplicand bits, accumulating shifted multiplier into a 32-bit product register and pulsing done.

anchors.name: start
anchors.why: Starts and sustains multiplication; deasserting clears bit counter

anchors.name: i
anchors.why: Shift count sequencing load, 16 accumulate steps and done

anchors.name: areg
anchors.why: Latched multiplicand whose bits gate each accumulate

anchors.name: breg
anchors.why: Latched multiplier shifted and added into product

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: One-cycle completion pulse from done_r at count 16

groups.name: Sequence control
groups.description: Bit counter and completion flag generation
